Open letter · 1 October 2026

Gambling industry funding and political safeguards

On 1 October 2026, researchers, charities, people with lived experience and young people formally delivered an open letter to UK political leaders calling on parties to voluntarily decline donations, gifts and hospitality from commercial gambling interests.

The letter asks parties to consider whether the stronger independence safeguards now applied to gambling-harms research, prevention and treatment should also be reflected in political funding.
